name: Hardtack
descriptions: A hard, dry biscuit, made out of flour and water.
effects: You eat the hardtack, it's dry and bland but it's filling.
As you take a bite, you can feel your teeth almost cracking before the biscuit finally breaks.
A bland and dry paste forms in your mouth, a dense cheweing material that reduces your hunger.

name: bully beef can
descriptions: A type of canned, cured meat. A concoction of gelatin, fat, finely minced pre-cooked meat, and salts.
Remarkably catfood-like in sight, texture and flavor!
effects: You eat the bully beaf straight, with a metalic taste that engulfs your whole mouth, the soft texture, it is like eating a savory raw cookie dough, but with a gelatinous aftertaste.
Eating the whole can, you can feel the paste of cured meats all around your gums and teeth, the metalic taste reaches your nostrils.
The cracking open of the can releases a pungent aroma, a paste of cured meats and fat.

name: bacon strip
descriptions: A strip of raw bacon, cured pork belly, sliced into strips, saltier than you'd expect.
It has a smoky and salty aroma, with a hint of sweetness.
Meats prepared this way have a longer shelf-life, making them a staple for long voyages.
effects: You munch on the raw bacon, the saltiness is overwhelming, it's like eating a salt lick with a hint of smoke.
The fat is gelatinous and slick, coating your mouth in a greasy film.
The raw bacon makes your stomach churn, the salt and fat are too much to handle, and the texture is just... wrong.

name: molasses ration
descriptions: A ration of molasses, a thick, dark syrup made from sugarcane.
It is sweet and sticky, with a rich, caramel-like flavor.
A dark roasted flavor, with a hint of smoke.
effects: You eat the molasses ration, it's sweet and sticky, with a rich, caramel-like flavor.
You fight to swallow the sticky sweet, dense liquid, it coats your mouth and throat.
The molasses ration makes your stomach churn, the sweetness is overwhelming, and the texture is just... wrong.

name: Water Barrel
descriptions: A barrel of water, used for drinking and cooking.
It is full of fresh water, perfect for a long voyage.
The water is clear and refreshing, with a hint of salt.
effects: You drink the water from the barrel, it's refreshing and hydrating.
The water is cold and crisp, it quenches your thirst immediately.
The water is salty and briny, it makes your stomach churn.
